description: Summary of extra experiments reported in the IEEE Access version

wider_delay_ablation.description: STORM retrained with delay upper bounds 1.5–4.0 h (fifteen seeds each). PE remains stable; original [0.5, 1.5] h bound is not a performance bottleneck.

bagged_transformer_control.description: Sixteen-seed bagged Transformer control. Bagging improves the Transformer, but the gap relative to bagged STORM remains.

notes: All PE values are PE_clim (vs climatology).
Main table numbers match the papers (fifteen seeds, chronological split).
Wider-delay and bagged-Transformer experiments support the Discussion paragraphs in the Access paper.
